newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian minister to visit Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian minister to visit Lebanon.

text.p: Brazilian Foreign Minister Luiz Felipe Lampreia will go to Beirut next week, the first senior Brazilian official to visit Lebanon, diplomats said on Thursday.

"This represents a ground-breaking visit to a country...in an area that merits diplomatic attention," said Jose Vicente de Sa Pimentel, head of the foreign ministry's Africa and Middle East department. Lampreia will visit Lebanon Feb. 3-6.

Pimentel said cultural ties were extensive, with six to eight million Brazilians descended from Lebanese immigrants. He said 35 Brazilian deputies, five senators and perhaps four state governors had Lebanese blood.
Lampreia was expected to sign accords on cultural cooperation and air travel. After Lebanon, he is due to visit Spain.
